text: むかつくぜ　やつあたり　でも　するか！

structure.jp: やつあたり　でも　するか！
structure.en: guess I'll take it out on someone or something!

patterns.name: 〜でも
patterns.explanation: でも after a thing offers it as one loose idea: 'or something'. やつあたり　でも = 'taking it out on someone, or something'.

patterns.name: 〜か (deciding)
patterns.explanation: か after a plain verb, said to yourself, means you are settling on what to do: 'guess I'll'. するか = 'guess I'll do it'.

patterns.name: 〜ぜ
patterns.explanation: ぜ at the end is rough, tough-guy stress on what you say. むかつくぜ = 'man, this ticks me off'.
